propositions: Every acceptance-criterion checkbox must be independently classified as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested, with criterion-specific evidence supporting the classification.
Externally verifiable criteria lacking the exact [operator-attested] tag or bearing a malformed near-miss must produce a remediation finding that names the correct syntax.
Codebase-verifiable criteria incorrectly tagged [operator-attested] must produce a finding explaining that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof.
Criteria mixing repository proof and outside-world proof must not be silently assigned a single evidence kind; the criterion must be split into independently certifiable items.
High-confidence evidence-kind misclassification findings must participate in normal blocking policy, while deterministic keyword detection remains fail-open and advisory.
